channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Duo Years Around The Sun aims to capture ‘transcendent sentimental beauty’ in new album
item.description: Years Around The Sun has self-released three albums and are set to release their fourth, “The Other Side of Sound,” on March 20.

item.title: MTS releases a ‘commute calculator’ to help motorists save money using public transit
item.description: The calculator factors in information such as commuting miles, estimated miles per gallon, parking costs, and price per gallon of fuel.

item.title: Point Loma softball has talent to win another CIF championship
item.description: To start the season, the Pointers were ranked No. 2 in the CIF San Diego Section, which includes San Diego and Imperial counties.

item.title: Drop Cesar Chavez name from landmarks, holidays, Congressional Hispanic Caucus says
item.description: There are parks, schools and streets across the U.S. that bear Chavez’s name, including the Cesar E. Chavez National Monument in the Tehachapi Mountains.

item.title: She was Dolores Huerta’s strategist, then her friend. Now she calls César Chávez a monster
item.description: We spoke with Patricia Portillo about her reaction to the revelations, given her long relationship with the famed 96‑year‑old labor activist.

item.title: Fue portavoz de Dolores Huerta, luego su amiga. Ahora llama a César Chávez un monstruo
item.description: No puedo imaginar lo que está pasando a la señora Dolores. La fortaleza que ha tenido por tantos años, y yo sin saber que ella llevaba un dolor tan profundo en su corazón. Y ahora va a cumplir 96 años, pero nunca es tarde. Y Dolores nos ha demostrado eso.

item.title: ‘Nunca es tarde para hablar’, dicen políticos latinos en el caso de Dolores Huerta
item.description: La publicación del artículo del New York Times revelando los abusos sexuales cometidos por César Chávez en contra de Dolores Huerta, hoy de 95 años y otras mujeres jóvenes que participaban en el movimiento campesino en la década de los sesenta, ha generado una reacción en cadena de parte de representantes latinos de todo el país.

item.title: Wounded man arrives at fire station, dies after attempts to save him
item.description: The Alpine Fire Protection District notified the sheriff's office that they had a shooting victim at the station early Wednesday.

item.title: ‘Mi silencio acaba aquí’: declaración de Dolores Huerta acerca de los abusos sexuales en su contra
item.description: Esta es la declaración textual hecha por Dolores Huerta, la dirigente campesina de 95 años que decidió no mantener por más tiempo en silencio los abusos sexuales cometidos en su contra por César Chávez y que dieron como resultado dos embarazos. item.title: Campillo ballot proposal to keep beach, bay parking free advances
item.description: The San Diego City Council's Rules Committee Wednesday initially approved a proposed ballot measure by Councilman Raul Campillo to keep parking at the city's beaches and bays free unless voters decide otherwise.
